headline: Learning design informed by real learner needs.
introduction: I connect instructional design, training delivery, learner support, and team collaboration to create learning that is practical, purposeful, and accessible.
experience_body: At Pearson, I contributed across instructional design and training-related responsibilities, supported colleagues in different roles, and stepped in to help facilitate training when needed. Firsthand interaction with learners helped me see where instruction worked well and where it needed to change.
leadership_body: I value clear communication, purposeful collaboration, learner feedback, and practical solutions. I help teams align on goals, document decisions, and improve learning through iteration.
focus_points: Translate stakeholder needs into measurable learning objectives
Design digital, instructor-led, and blended learning
Coordinate reviews, timelines, and cross-functional feedback
Use learner feedback and evaluation to refine solutions
